title: Tap and Clap · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Tap and Clap · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a four-beat pattern using gentle table taps and claps. The lead performs the pattern once and a partner copies it. The partner repeats the four actions in order. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Tap and Clap, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The partner repeats the four actions in order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The partner repeats the four actions in order.
